subject: Warning message about "number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length"

messages.author: d3ab311743d71402
messages.subject: Warning message about "number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length"
parts:
Hi:

Running the following code:

formula <- nacimientos ~ -1 + f(comarca, model="iid") + f(interaction(any, comarca), model="iid") + f(interaction(edad, comarca), model="iid")

salida.inla <- inla(formula, offset=log(nac_base), family="poisson", data = DatosMujyNac2010_2013com, control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE), verbose=TRUE)

I've found this warning:

Warning message:
In po2.res[xx[seq(1L, len, by = 3L)] + 1L] = xx[seq(3L, len, by = 3L)] :
  number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length

which I don't know how to interpret.

Thanks in advance.
